Chapter 433 - 433 Tragic; Special Medicine!

Chapter 433 - 433 Tragic; Special Medicine!

433 Tragic; Special Medicine!

Sha City.

In a vast courtyard.

Old Master Hu Nanshan, Hu Kaixuan, Hu Guodong, Hu Tian, and many other members of the Hu family were standing at the door. Their faces were full of sorrow, and there were people sobbing and discussing.

“Shaodong… Shaodong…”

“I hope it’s not true.”

“Why is this happening?”

Back then, when Old Master Hu Nanshan celebrated his birthday, he received a lot of Spirit Tea from Lin Fan.

If it was consumed normally, it would definitely have the effect of prolonging life.

Now, however, Hu Nanshan’s face looked even more aged than when he had celebrated his birthday.

When Hu Nanshan heard the voices of the crowd, he raised his eyebrows.

“Why are you crying? Shaodong was injured for the sake of the citizens. We must be proud of him! I’ll see who dares to cry later!”

It had to be said that Hu Nanshan had a very high status in the Hu family.

As soon as he finished speaking, everyone from the Hu family stopped sobbing.

Hu Kaixuan took a deep breath and said, “We must be proud of Shaodong!”

At this moment…

Three jeeps and an ambulance slowly stopped.

A large group of soldiers and doctors carried an unconscious man whose face was covered in wounds.

This man was Hu Tian’s second brother, Hu Shaodong!

If one looked closely, one would notice that Hu Shaodong’s face was not the only part injured. There were many wounds on his body.

In fact, his legs had completely disappeared.

He… He had become disabled!

Even though everyone in the Hu family already knew about this and even though the old man had already reprimanded everyone, everyone’s eyes turned red after seeing Hu Shaodong’s miserable appearance.

At this moment, a middle-aged man with an emblem on his shoulder came to Hu Nanshan.

“Old Leader, I’m sorry. I couldn’t protect Shaodong well and caused him to be so seriously injured. I…”

“What are you talking about?” Hu Nanshan interrupted.

“He’s a warrior!”

“Since he’s a warrior, he should be prepared to make sacrifices at any time!

“Also, a warrior should be the one protecting others.”

Hu Nanshan could not help but look at Hu Shaodong. “We… I’m proud of him!”

“Yes, Sir!” The man with the emblem on his shoulder shouted.

Then, Hu Shaodong was carried into the room.

As for the soldiers with the emblem, they did not stay any longer. After saluting Hu Nanshan, they turned around and left.

After all, they were soldiers and had many missions to deal with.

After the soldiers left, the Hu family looked at the doctors and nurses who were checking Hu Shaodong’s hideous wounds and changing his dressing. They could not help but cry.

The bone-scraping pain woke Hu Shaodong up.

He rolled his eyes with difficulty and said in a hoarse voice, “I… I… This is…”

Zhong Hongting choked and said, “Shaodong, it’s okay. It’s okay. You’re home now…”

Hu Shaodong blinked his eyes in realization. A hot tear rolled down his face.

Who said that men did not cry? Men did not cry just because they had not reached that point of sadness!

At this moment, the phone in Hu Tian’s pocket vibrated slightly.

She looked at the caller ID. It was Lin Fan.

Although Hu Tian was very sad, she still pressed the answer button.

“Teacher Tiantian, I’ve arrived at the entrance of the courtyard,” Lin Fan said.

Hu Tian sniffed and said, “Alright, I’ll come and fetch you now.”

After all, there were guards guarding the entrance of the courtyard where the Hu family lived. Outsiders were not allowed to enter and exit as they pleased.

When Hu Tian saw Lin Fan, it was as if she had found someone to rely on. She could not help but throw herself into his arms as tears rolled down her cheeks.

Lin Fan patted Hu Tian’s shoulder lightly and said, “It’s okay. I’m here. Second Brother will be fine… Take me to see him first.”

Hu Tian thought that Lin Fan was comforting her and nodded her head gently.

Thus, the two of them walked side by side to the Hu family’s courtyard.

When Lin Fan saw that Hu Shaodong was lying on a hospital bed with injuries all over his body and realized that he had lost both his legs, his expression changed slightly.

Even though he had Sun Simiao’s Medical Experience, there was no way to treat someone who had lost both legs.

Now, he could only place his hopes on Medical Water.

In fact…

Lin Fan did not have much hope for it.

After a while, Lin Fan said, “I have a bottle of special medicine here. It should be able to help Second Brother Hu.”

As he spoke, he spent ten million yuan to buy a bottle of Medical Water from the system.

Everyone from the Hu family could not help but look at Lin Fan.

Hu Nanshan also noticed Lin Fan and said, “You’re so thoughtful.”

Clearly, he still remembered Lin Fan.

This was normal.

After all, it was all because of Lin Fan that Qin Weiming and Zhang Jian, the two pillars of the nation, asked Commander Yue Zixiao to come over to congratulate him.

Lin Fan said, “I’ll go give this to Second Brother Hu now.”

Drink it now?

How could Hu Shaodong drink something casually in his current condition?

Hu Nanshan was about to refuse.

However, he soon thought of the Spirit Tea.

During this period of time, he often drank it.

Every time he drank a cup, he felt refreshed.

After a while, Hu Nanshan felt that all the small problems in his body had disappeared.

If he had heard the news that Hu Shaodong was seriously injured and lost both his legs in the past, before he started drinking the Spirit Tea, he would have died.

Hu Nanshan looked much younger than before!

Lin Fan had magical tea leaves.

Perhaps, he also had a magic potion!

Thinking of this, Hu Nanshan said, “Then I’ll have to trouble you, Lin Fan.”

With Hu Nanshan’s approval, the others naturally did not say anything.

When Lin Fan came to Hu Dong’s side, Hu Tian saw his miserable state up close and could not help but hold Lin Fan’s hand tightly.

Lin Fan patted the back of her hand and said softly, “It’ll be fine.”

He was very sure.

Even though Lin Fan still did not know if the Medical Water would have any effect on him, he had the system and seven billion red packets!

There must be a way to solve the problem of this man’s legs.

Lin Fan said, “Second Brother Hu, please open your mouth.”

Hu Shaodong blinked his eyes and opened his trembling mouth.

Under everyone’s gaze, he slowly drank the Medical Water.

When the Medical Water entered his stomach, Hu Shaodong felt a warm current flowing through his stomach.

Then, his body, which was originally in extreme pain, quickly became relaxed and comfortable.

In the eyes of outsiders, the hideous wounds on Hu Shaodong’s body were healing at a speed visible to the naked eye.

This scene…

Everyone’s eyes almost popped out of their sockets.
